finding: Adversarial source-conservation review of the 0.5 successor found that its expanded W097 body accidentally dropped two source-visible predecessor/W05 semantics: the explicit ordinary-versus-twistor contrast and the explicit antipodal characterization of rho_tw. W05 §2 also states the ordinary real-point locus as a circle/affine real line. These facts are preserved in the successor before any G1 consumer is allowed.

correction.corrected_body: W05 defines a real structure on CP1 as an antiholomorphic map rho: CP1 -> CP1 with rho squared equal to 1. The ordinary real structure is complex conjugation rho([z1,z2])=[bar(z1),bar(z2)]; its real points are exactly the points fixed by rho, forming a circle in CP1 (the real line in the affine z coordinate). W05 explicitly contrasts this ordinary real structure with the twistor antipodal real structure rho_tw, defined by rho_tw([z1,z2])=[-bar(z2),bar(z1)] (equivalently rho_tw(z)=-1/bar(z)); on C2 coordinates rho_tw squared equals -1, while on projective points rho_tw squared equals 1, and on the sphere rho_tw is the antipodal map with no projective fixed points. W05 also presents the same twistor P1 as the real projective conic x^2+y^2+z^2=0 in projective two-space, defined over the real numbers, with complex points but no real points.
